how: We read the website of every Washington DC wedding photographer listed on Lazo (138 listings, 107 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a commercial and celebrity portrait studio, portrait and mitzvah generalists, a videographer's duplicate listing, and sites that never say what they shoot. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: If I want portraits at the monuments or the Tidal Basin, do you handle the National Park Service permit, and how do you work around cherry blossom crowds?
Can I see a full gallery from a wedding at a venue like mine, not just the highlights?
What is the delivery timeline, and is a second shooter included or an add-on?

picks.name: RW Photography
picks.blurb: Ryan has photographed weddings across Virginia, DC and Maryland for over 16 years, more than 150 of them, in a candid, natural-light style. He describes his approach as guiding the day when needed and stepping back when real moments happen, so photography never feels like one more thing to stress about.

picks.name: Catch Motion Studio
picks.blurb: Catch Motion Studio has captured over 1,200 luxury South Asian weddings since 2013, blending photojournalism with artistic storytelling in both photography and cinematography. Based in Ashburn and serving couples nationwide, with a stated focus on the rituals and traditions of Indian weddings.

picks.name: Natasha Lamalle Photography
picks.blurb: A documentary wedding photographer based in Silver Spring, born and raised in France, with a bachelor's degree in history and a master's in journalism. Natasha's goal is photos that make you feel like you are back in the room, shot across DC, Maryland and Virginia.

picks.name: La Vie En Rose Photographers
picks.blurb: Four women on a mission to let couples live in the moment, documenting every second of the day for people who are, in their words, the perfect mix of sophisticated and fun. Based in Alexandria, with weddings, destinations and elopements.

picks.name: Arvin Photography LLC
picks.blurb: Arvin Photography offers luxury, full-service wedding photography across DC, Virginia and Maryland, built on relationships that start at the first conversation and run to final delivery. Collections start at $4,999, and the site says so up front so you can check the fit before a meeting.

picks.name: Mason Photography
picks.blurb: Adam Mason makes colorful photos for colorful people, and describes himself as the almost-always-smiling bearded guy in a black t-shirt. His pitch is that wedding photography should make you feel something and document your family's story, and that you do not fit in a box, so he will not put you in one.

picks.name: Photographick Studios
picks.blurb: A couture boutique studio for multi-day and multicultural weddings, with Hindu, Sikh and interfaith celebrations as its specialty, in both photography and cinematography. Based in the DC area, travels extensively, and lists publications from NBC's Platinum Weddings to Washingtonian Bride & Groom and Maharani Weddings.

picks.name: M Carter Photography
picks.blurb: Marcus came to photography from project management, and it shows in his pitch: intentional timelines and logistics handled behind the scenes so the couple can simply exist in the moment. True-to-color work for over 75 couples across the DMV and Pennsylvania, and a multi-year recipient of The Knot's Best of Weddings and WeddingWire's Couples' Choice.

picks.name: Benson Park Photography
picks.blurb: Aidan is a Marine Corps veteran turned full-time wedding photographer, shooting roughly 30 or more weddings a year since 2017. His process promises a first look within 72 hours and a four-to-eight-week turnaround, with a pricing guide published on the site.

picks.name: Whysall Photography, LLC
picks.blurb: Steve Whysall is a photojournalist with 25-plus years and over 1,000 weddings behind him, and every wedding comes with two photographers. He prints his packages: a two-hour ceremony-only package is $1,500, with multiple locations covered.

picks.name: Wedding Photojournalism by Rodney Bailey Washington DC
picks.blurb: Photojournalism by Rodney Bailey is a boutique wedding and event studio with over 30 years in the business that has documented thousands of events, letting couples stay present while the day is recorded as it organically occurs. Covers DC, Northern Virginia and Maryland.

picks.name: Photography Du Jour LLC
picks.blurb: Shauna Ploeger shoots both film and digital with a timeless, candid appeal, and over the past decade her work has taken her from Panama and St. Maarten to Scotland. She lives in Virginia hunt country at the base of the Blue Ridge, is currently booking 2027 dates and travels worldwide.
